title: Malisima
body: No tiene alarmas ni nada !!!... Se supone que es para que me recuerde y notifique las tareas 😕
author: lunahga..

title: Devs not reliable
body: Purchased this app, paid for their one-time-payment premium then two weeks later I wake up to a “subscribe to premium” offer. I’ve tried contacting the dev but have not received any response.
author: ansgardi

title: Payment model switched without warning
body: I made a one-time payment for the premium version of this app because I really liked it and it was one of the few habit tracking apps with that model of payment, but all of a sudden today I’m back to a “free” plan an obligated to go into a subscription plan if I want to go back to premium. Very deceptive.
author: renalbac

title: Amo esta app
body: Me ayuda a llevar track de los hábitos que quiero formar en mi vida
author: Claubadia

title: Justo lo que buscaba
body:
Antes hacía este monitoreo de mis hábitos en las notas del teléfono, era muy aburrido; con esta app es colorido y divertido.

¡Me encanta! ♥️
author: El Fiuri

title: Review
body: I love the app, simple but functional. I would like to report that if I need to setup a reminder once per week, I need to have a day of the week that I’d like to add it to. Don’t see it in the app. Besides this, excellent app.
author: Pedro Guillermo
